root_cause_summary.root_cause: The legacy stack belongs to Thaumcraft content that is not fully registered or flattened in the NeoForge port yet.
The stack exists only in Minecraft 1.21.1 or is exposed by a 1.21-only component/sample manifest.
Resolved runtime AspectList matches after an explicit legacy-to-modern id or metadata mapping.
The stack is exposed as its own 1.21 id instead of the 1.12 registry-id/meta shape, or it was added after 1.12.2.
Minecraft 1.21 exposes per-entity spawn egg ids; legacy 1.12 used a generic spawn_egg stack and Thaumcraft returned no aspects for it.
The stack is a damageable item added after Minecraft 1.12.2, so there is no exact legacy runtime target.
1.21.1 has additional potion or enchantment ids, or the sampled component form has no 1.12 equivalent.
The enchantment id does not exist in Minecraft 1.12.2 or only exists under an explicitly mapped legacy name.
The music disc id was added after Minecraft 1.12.2.
The key exists only in the 1.12.2 dump.
